answer: We model a Sybil-resistant architecture where the structural timber of the consensus network relies on dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and quadratic staking collateral. By leveraging zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions, adversarial expected utility reaches its zenith at a negative value, as subgame-perfect slashing matrices neutralize identity multiplication. This solid marble of cryptoeconomic commitment guarantees that honest validation converges to a unique, strict Nash equilibrium.
